title: P42645PW corn (Pioneer P42645PW): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: P42645PW corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: P42645PW corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Mindanao. 107 to 109 days to harvest, 6.8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: P42645PW corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as Pioneer P42645PW or P42645. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2026 as NSIC 2026 GMCn 103. Corteva Agriscience bred it. It takes 107 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 6.77 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Pioneer P42645PW or P42645, this is the same corn. Its seller and farm sources add notes, listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

items: **Days to harvest:** 107 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 6.77 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

P42645PW corn takes 107 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 6.77 t/ha trails the average of its group, 8.13. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives 116 to 120 days after planting (Pioneer), 107 to 109 in national trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ear length in the trials: WS = 16.80, DS=16.40. The shelling recovery was WS = 75.93 percent, DS=77.72 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** Potential 13 t/ha (Pioneer), national trials 6.77 t/ha in Mindanao.

**Traits in the seed:** PowerCore (MON 89034 x TC1507 x NK603): three Bt proteins (Cry1A.105, Cry2Ab2, Cry1F) against corn borer, earworm, fall armyworm and other caterpillars, plus glyphosate (Roundup) tolerance, 95:5 refuge seed blend.
Spacing 70 x 20 cm or 60 x 20 cm.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: pioneer's current highland Mindanao hybrid, second in the GM class (8.39 t/ha) of DA 12's 2025 dry season trial in Senator Ninoy Aquino, Sultan Kudarat. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant P42645PW corn

It is recommended for Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Pioneer P42645PW the same as P42645PW?
items.a: Yes. Pioneer P42645PW is another name for P42645PW, registered as NSIC 2026 GMCn 103. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 107 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 6.77 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
It is recommended for Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of P42645PW?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
